title: Straight-line acceleration, braking, top speed and reverse
description: 500 m asphalt straight from BENCHMARKS.md 'Handling fixtures' (Straight row): standing and 30 m/s rolling starts covering acceleration, braking, top speed and reverse. Road width is an authored initial value; BENCHMARKS specifies only the length and surface.

geometry.start_reference: World origin at the start of segment 0 on the centerline; forward -Z, right +X, up +Y.

segments.note: Authored initial width; BENCHMARKS specifies 500 m asphalt only. GAME_DESIGN course widths generally range 9-20 m.

runs.description: Standing start, full throttle held; measures the acceleration curve and time to the stock top speed.

driver.note: Single entry holds to the end of the run. The schedule needs no measured end time; run length is the 500 m geometry.

runs.description: 30 m/s rolling start, full throttle held; measures top speed against the documented 205-235 km/h stock range.
30 m/s rolling start, full throttle, then full braking at the authored trigger time; measures the braking phase.

driver.note: The 2 s brake trigger is an authored initial value; BENCHMARKS specifies no braking point. Braking distance itself is an M1 measurement, not a value claimed here.

runs.description: Standing start with brake held; reverse must engage only below 1 m/s after a 0.3 s hold (GAME_DESIGN controls contract).

timing_gates.purpose: Authored intermediate marker at 250 m; a position marker only, unrelated to the braking run's brake command at t_s 2.

expected_events.note: Reaching a speed within the documented stock range is expected; the measured value is recorded by M1 reference runs, not asserted here.

comparison.purpose: Record the stock acceleration, braking, top-speed and reverse envelopes for the three starters at stock and maximum upgrades.

metrics.name: stock_top_speed_kmh
metrics.description: Documented stock top-speed target range from GAME_DESIGN; upgraded caps are applied by the loadout, not stored in the fixture.

metrics.name: standing_acceleration_and_braking_records
metrics.description: Record acceleration/braking envelopes per car and loadout. No pass/fail threshold is claimed before M1 measurements.

comparison.note: Measured envelopes are produced by M1 reference runs against this fixture; this file carries no measured values.

cars.note: BENCHMARKS handling comparisons use all three starters at stock and maximum upgrades.

unknowns.reason: car.balanced_starter is the fixed ID of the balanced starter (Comet) from BENCHMARKS; the Sparrow and Slidewinder IDs are working names until the M1 car registry assigns stable IDs.

The per-car handling resource (../handling_config.schema.json) is M1 work; the revision this fixture targets is undetermined until M1 assigns it. BENCHMARKS regenerates reference records when handling dependencies change, so the fixture records the target revision instead of duplicating coefficients.
